text:
sara_sales: FYI — Regulatory pilot customer wants a fully air-gapped/on‑prem sealed deployment. Main asks: upgrade cadence (they prefer monthly patches), bundle transport over physical media, signing/provenance, HSM/KMS integration, and a pricing outline for 'monthly security patch' support. Anyone with packaging notes?

omar_se: We did similar for OrgX last year. Key constraints: no outbound telemetry, no automatic update checks. We ship an immutable bundle + detached signature + SBOM. For delta approach we can provide xdelta-based patches but customer needs a verified apply path.

kyle_eng: Tech caveats: runtime requires GPU drivers + our kernel module on the host; offline nodes must have those pre-installed. For zero-downtime patching we recommend blue/green node swap if they can afford duplicate capacity. Otherwise rolling replace that verifies signatures before starting process.

maria_security: From questionnaire POV: they asked about cert rotation offline. Short answer: support offline rotation using signed rotation-pack that contains new certs + signature from their enterprise CA; our installer verifies and stores new certs locally. We can integrate with HSM (PKCS#11) for key wrapping; FIPS 140-2 HSMs are supported for private keystores. Need to confirm vendor model.

omar_se: Packaging details: bundle layout we supply: 
```
bundle.tar.gz
  |- manifest.json  # metadata, version, requirements, checksum
  |- sbom.json
  |- payload/       # images and binaries (already pre-quantized when requested)
  |- delta/         # optional xdelta patches between versions
```
Verification command example we give to customer: 
```
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz
```
We also support GPG detached signatures if their ops team prefers.

sara_sales: Pricing ask: customer expects a 'monthly security patch' plan priced per-site/year. How do we quote? Also they want SLA for patch turnaround (7 business days) and backporting critical CVEs.

kyle_eng: For pricing tech input: delta patches reduce transfer size significantly — helpful when physical shipping costs apply. Work estimate for monthly patch support: ~0.5 FTE of eng + 0.2 FTE support per ~10 sites. For SOW we usually quote a platform annual license + yearly support tier + per-patch engineering retainer for aggressive cadence.

maria_security: Add compliance add-on: extended audit logs + deeper SBOM provenance (signed component hashes), costs extra. Also they'll need an attestations workflow for legal.

omar_se: Ops notes for field team: ensure jumpbox workflow documented. Typical transport paths we've seen: secure jumpbox via rsync over SSH with sealed USB fallback. We provide a verification checklist so they can validate offline bundles before applying.

ops-bot: build-bundle/4123456789 completed: bundle v2026.03.21-rc1 (signed) — checksums: sha256:abcd... , sbom attached.

sara_sales: Great. Action items: 1) Omar/Kyle — draft the offline packaging + signature checklist for the customer by EOD tomorrow. 2) Maria — draft answers for cert rotation + HSM Qs to drop into their security questionnaire. 3) Sales — I'll put together a pricing skeleton with license + quarterly vs monthly patch tier options and an engineering retainer option.

omar_se: Will do. Also flagging one blocker: if they demand hot-patch binary diffs only (no full bundle allowed), we need a signed migration plan — otherwise we recommend full signed bundles for reproducibility.

kyle_eng: Noted. If customer prefers monthly small diffs, we'll recommend xdelta + pre-checksums + staged verify. That keeps payload <20MB typically.

maria_security: I'll add language about key custody and recommended rotation cadence (90 days) and emergency rotation playbook.

sara_sales: Thanks team :+1: I'll schedule a 30m call with their infra lead for Friday to walk through transport and signing.
